newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai police detain Malaysian over Ecstasy pills.
newsitem.headline: Thai police detain Malaysian over Ecstasy pills.

text.p: Thai police on Tuesday detained a Malaysian man suspected of trying to smuggle Ecstasy pills into Thailand, customs officials said.

Neow Hien Fatt, 32, was arrested at Bangkok international airport after he flew in from Amsterdam. Customs officials said they found 20,000 Ecstasy pills hidden in a secret compartment in his luggage.
Police put the value of the pills at about 25 million baht ($1 million).
Thailand classifies Ecstasy as a top-grade narcotic and convicted traffickers could face the death penalty.
